math_steps.name: Materialize four-token unions with row membership
Stream two half-denominators against a shared lagged reference
Normalize and preserve both output roundings

mapping.strategy: SMCount is queried from device properties.

schedule.strategy: Cached device ticket and host base start at zero; each serialized eager call consumes worktile_count+worker_count tickets and advances the host base by that amount, using signed-int32 wrap-safe subtraction without a counter reset.

refill.atomic_counter: One scheduler thread per CTA atomically claims one ticket minus the launch base; IDs below worktile_count follow worktile_order, and each CTA stops on its first terminal ticket.

worker_assignment.exit: Terminal ticket acknowledged by all roles, all acquired work complete, and all in-flight accesses drained.

verb.build: Clear Hash and CompactCount, cache row counts/requests and request-zero PageTable, then rendezvous. Stream 16-byte index quads one item ahead in registers; one CAS/linear-probing insertion per nonempty group merges membership with atomic OR by every inserter, including the creator. Rendezvous before compaction.
verb.compact: Each warp prefix-scans contiguous hash-slot ranges, atomically reserves an output interval, and emits Union; publish Count after all writes. Warp reservation order is unspecified.

verb.publish: Claim and post a ticket; done means readable. Before claiming the following ticket, await all eleven consumer warps' copies and acknowledgements of the current ticket. Acknowledgement permits one-worktile lookahead while that work is still executing. Ticket0 is the first ticket; Next(t) includes the terminal ticket, whose acknowledgement is required before exit.
verb.wait: Join all consumer acknowledgements before posting the following ticket or retiring the terminal ticket.

accept.meaning: Copy and acknowledge the published ticket; terminal tickets start no work.

verb.load: Prime address lookahead per worktile, then resolve Union two tiles ahead and block_table one ahead, clamped to that worktile's last tile. Resolve one base per union-entry position and share it within the gather warp across that entry's token/channel copies; issue the current paged copy into KeyRing. load:Kblk(n) becomes done only after issuing tile n+1 and publishing n's completed copy. Carry delayed publication across worktiles; drain publishes the final outstanding tile.

drain.meaning: After the terminal ticket, finish and publish the last outstanding gather if any data was loaded. If Ticket0 was already terminal, no gather exists and this action completes without waiting for a last tile.

verb.load: Follow GatherK's address lookahead and delayed publication for ValueRing, adding the V base delta and using the value-product orientation.

wait.meaning: Wait for the initial Q publication even when Ticket0 is terminal.

verb.mma: QK initializes S and each worktile's first PV initializes Y. Cumulative completion includes operand reads; PV(n) reads P before a later QK overwrites its aliased S/P stage.

verb.accept: Copy and acknowledge the published ticket; terminal tickets start no work.
verb.publish:
Qblk0 gathers real packed rows for min(Ticket0,worktile_count-1), including unused payload on an initial terminal ticket.
HalfMax_A captures all S[:,0:Bk/2] into registers, writes this HalfMax half and joins B's 256-thread rendezvous.
Both score halves have been captured before either group overwrites the aliased stage with P; HalfMax_A done precedes peer-maximum capture.
P_A captures the peer maximum and evaluates online from the retained register scores. rescale_peer(p) is the 32-row interval containing p, including padding.
Only warps with move_ref true wait for PV(n-1) when i>0, then A rescales all D columns of their Y rows before publishing P_A.
Prime membership per worktile; retain the current packed mask through weight formation while prefetching raw words for min(i+1,N(b)-1) in registers. Count masks dead entries when packing the next mask.
HalfMax overwrite safety has not been established; no extra read-complete barrier is assumed.
Qnext completes the issued Q refill and publishes readiness after this group's final Y read; terminal Next(t) is a no-op.

prefetch.meaning: Issue the next valid ticket's Q gather into Qblk after the current final QK has retired.

verb.combine: Exchange final L halves through HalfSum with a 256-thread rendezvous and capture the normalization factor.
verb.drain: Read Y[:,0:D/2] in 32-column pieces, gate/store the first pieces and retain the last in registers; done releases this half of Y before its final gate/store.
verb.store: Gate and directly store the retained final output piece on real rows.

verb.accept: Copy and acknowledge the published ticket; terminal tickets start no work.
verb.publish: Capture S[:,Bk/2:Bk] into registers before the shared HalfMax rendezvous; follow A's peer capture, correction vote and mask lookahead, forming this half of L and P from that register copy without modifying Y.
verb.combine: Follow A's HalfSum exchange and normalization capture.
verb.drain: Follow A's drain for Y[:,D/2:D], releasing this half before the final gate/store.
verb.store: Gate and directly store the retained final output piece on real rows.
